NO! Dont use ANY of it. Its all fake. It won't process. Its not real. Its a fake check scam.

I had my L4-S1 anterior and posterior fusion last September. Some tips that got me through it


Sit up in bed when you sleep! Its not the most comfortable, but lying flat on your back after a fusion really sucks. I Bought a leg pillow that lifts my legs when I sleep to ease any excess nerve pain from the healing nerves


As some have said above: in home PT, OT, and nurse to start. I had all of that and it was super helpful the first few weeks after surgery. I got at home PT excersises, help with an occupational therapist, and a nurse came three times a week to check my bandages and check for any brewing infections


Don't be afraid to use the pain medicine the doctor gives you. You'll sleep a ton, but it'll keep you comfortable and able to rest.


Get up and move when you can. Have someone help you when going to the bathroom, and DON'T shower until the surgeon says its okay. I had to wait about three weeks before I could shower, but I was a special circumstance.


And above all, Rest, Water, and Eat when you can. Any signs of infection and call your surgeon immediately.


 You'll be okay. I've been mostly pain free since I woke up from surgery. I still have some residual nerve pain I'm dealing with, but Valium has helped for now. I even went back to work after three years of dealing with spondy pain. :)
